payload.title: judge_replay and mutation_canary build their own path-and-message item and mint without evidence refs or a repo root, so since the cited-line change the live judges are handed the cited line and its excerpt while replay recall and the canary self-exam still measure the old question, and the docstring that says replay measures the same question stays true only because a test pins the difference.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_replay.py:75-81 (comment: a replayed judge is asked the live question, recall on a different question is not recall; the full adapter finding is resolved here)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_replay.py:149-153 (the replay item keeps rule, severity, path and message and drops the finding's evidence)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_replay.py:161-166 (the replay mint passes no evidence_refs and no context_repo_root)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:385-390 (the canary envelope item is likewise path and message only, its path a file:line string)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:173-176 (judge_request_fields claims the live fan-out and the replay mint through it so replay recall measures the same question live judges answer)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:552-571 (the live mint hands the refs and the repo root, so the packer quotes the window around the cited line)
aria-kernel/tests/test_judge_input_cites_the_line.py:197-207 (a test pins that the replay-shaped item has no line row, so the divergence stays green)
payload.rule_violated: ARIA-HIGH-324 contract stated at judge_replay.py:75-78 and judge_fanout.py:173-176: one question for live judges and replayed judges; one owner of the sample item (feedback_store._sample_item_from_finding) instead of private item builders.
payload.notes: For a gold item whose adapter finding is {path P, evidence [{P, line 120}]} the live fan-out now mints with refs [P, P:120], an excerpt covering line 120 and a prompt row 'line: 120'; the replay mint for the same finding resolves the full finding, copies only rule, path and message, and mints with no refs, no excerpt and no line row. Judge recall, ECE and accuracy computed from the replay: groups (compute_replay_recall, the canary self-exam) describe a regime live judges no longer run in, and the shipped docstrings say the opposite. The effect is latent while both lanes are held (ARIA-MEDIUM-713, ARIA-MEDIUM-1089) and appears with the first replay run. Close condition: Build the replay item and the canary envelope item through feedback_store._sample_item_from_finding from the resolved adapter finding and mint with the same evidence_refs and repo root as dispatch_judges_for_sample; replace the pin at test_judge_input_cites_the_line.py:197 with a test that judge_request_fields output (prompt, refs) for a replay item equals the live item's for the same finding. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
